title: Mesherra Policy Document v1
description: The user's signed constitution. One document per principal. Each document is a list of rules; each rule scopes how a specific payload schema may cross this principal's airlock. Per ARCHITECTURE.md §13.4 / §13.6 and demos/phase_3/SPEC.md §2.

principal_id.description: The principal this policy belongs to. Must match the principal whose signing key signed the doc.

version.description: Monotonically increasing integer. v1 is the first signed policy for a principal; every update increments.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the policy was signed.

schema.description: Payload schema URI this rule applies to.

direction.description: If omitted, the rule applies to both directions.

FieldPath.description: Dotted-path reference to a field. Top-level keys (`candidates`) or nested keys (`constraint_hints.tz`). Array indexing is NOT supported in v1.
